title: Studio Access: a dismissed or revoked suggested binding cannot be accepted again
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966, `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT`) from the out-of-scope finding of the #26846 developer report (comment 6464057205, PR #27148). #26846 item 5 asked for a re-grant control; the ui half was left out because the server has no door for it. Triage grades and routes.

## Symptom

In Studio › Access › Suggested bindings, once an admin dismisses a pending suggestion, or revokes an accepted one, the row stays `dismissed` (`GET /api/v1/security/suggested-bindings?packageId=…` lists it so) and nothing lets the admin change their mind. QA run `studio-qa-2026-10-27`, item A9.5.

## Cause (measured on `origin/main`)

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/suggested-audience-bindings.ts`:

- `confirmAudienceBindingSuggestion` refuses any non-pending row: "Audience-binding suggestion '…' is already dismissed — only pending suggestions can be accepted." (≈L1007).
- `dismissAudienceBindingSuggestion` moves a pending row, or a deployment-decision `confirmed` row (the revoke), to `dismissed` (≈L1089–1101).
- `syncAudienceBindingSuggestions` only creates `pending` rows for unanswered sets, marks observed baseline sets `confirmed`, and prunes stale `pending` rows. It never moves a `dismissed` row back.
- No route under the security domain (`packages/runtime/src/domains/security.ts`) re-opens a row.

So `dismissed` is terminal. The only way back is editing the `everyone` definition by hand.

## Expected

An admin can reverse a "no": either a door that moves a `dismissed` row back to `pending` (then the normal confirm applies, with ADR-0090 D7's high-risk gate), or `confirm` accepting a `dismissed` row directly. Whichever is chosen, Studio's suggestions panel then gets a re-grant control (a ui follow-up). If a dismissal is meant to be final under ADR-0090 D5, say so and close this.

## Filing facts

- Business reason: one mis-click on Dismiss or Revoke cannot be undone from the product.
- Reader who acts: triage first (domain is likely the security/server lane; it touches ADR-0090 D5 semantics), then that lane's implementer. The ui control follows once a door exists.
- Dedupe: REST issue search `suggested binding dismissed`, `suggested bindings reopen`, `suggestion re-grant` on objectstack-ai/objectstack: no hits.
